label: Basics 3 — The Canopy of Knowledge
description: The canopy of knowledge: the professional food domain, the sciences and engineering, medicine & mind, the humanities and the arts, and the cross-cutting knowledge map that crowns them. Heaviest; loads last, in the background.

_data_files: The measurement matrices this pack's own .ak files tell the operator to load (`io.ingest model=sty into=<work> path=app/ontology/base3/<name>.jsonl`). They are NOT ontology — they are the inputs a shipped instruction names, and they are declared here because the packer ships .ak and .json by extension and would otherwise leave a deployed cell following an instruction to a missing file.
